name: shop-siren~p2
task: Each time the siren starts ringing, turn it off.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: The clause is `RespondedExistence(siren_ringing, switch_toggled)` (hard). `RespondedExistence` allows the switch to be toggled before the siren starts ringing, which does NOT match the task wording “Each time the siren starts ringing, turn it off.” The task requires the toggle to happen after the ringing begins, i.e., on that step or later. Use a `Response(siren_ringing, switch_toggled)` hard clause (or a `ChainResponse` if “very next step” is intended) instead of `RespondedExistence`.

texts: Whenever the siren starts ringing, the agent must eventually toggle the siren switch to turn it off
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES:
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, siren_ringing&!switch_toggled) -> u1
(u1, switch_toggled) -> u0
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, siren_ringing&!switch_toggled, u1) -> -1
(u1, switch_toggled, u0) -> 1
